senses.gloss:
लुन्थ् लुन्थ् [cf. rts. 1. लुठ्, 1. लुट्], cl.
1. P. लुन्थति, &c., to strike, hurt,
kill; to afflict; to suffer pain.

लुनत्, अन्, अती, अत्, or लुनान, अस्, आ, अम्, cut-
ting, severing, dividing, reaping, cutting off, &c.

लून, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, severed, clipped; reaped;
plucked, gathered (said of flowers); cut off, cut
down, wounded; nibbled at, bitten; destroyed;
[]
(अम्), n. = लूम, a tail.
—लून-यवम्, ind. after
the barley has been cut, after barley-harvest.
—लून-
विष, अस्, आ, अम्, having poison in the tail.

लूनक, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, divided; (अस्), m. a cut,
division, wound, anything cut or broken; sort,
species, difference; an animal.

लूनि, इस्, f. the act of cutting, reaping, cutting off;
rice (?) .
